name: Savage Jaw
body:
Savage Jaw (Ex)
Source Champions of Corruption pg. 27
While raging, the barbarian can open her jaw wide and latch her teeth firmly onto her opponent. While using the animal fury power, the barbarian can activate this power as a free action and gain the grab ability with her bite attack until the start of her next turn. This power can be used only once per rage. A barbarian must have the animal fury rage power to select this rage power.
